events.title: Art Asset Update and Patch Notes
events.summary: As a solo dev I don't announce what just updated often. But usually I commit more than 20 changes per day to make the game better. What’s new since Sep 28A new pixel-art look. The streets, the Thought Gravity Field, the Omega fight and the menus are all pixel art now. The hero and NPCs are new 3D models, and the Core Base has a new layout.Every battle is on the front line. events.title: Genius Simulator Demo Update: Master's Deeper Meaning
events.summary: Thank you so much for all your support! Genius Simulator has arrived at its final major update for the Demo version. With this update, we are officially introducing the brand-new core system: "Master's Deeper Meaning"! Through this mechanic, players will truly experience how every tiny, mundane action you take in this world is wildly over-interpreted by "experts" as a profound, genius stroke of mastermind planning.
